entries.note: The README lists an open redirect on the login redirect page. res.redirect of that value is not a server-side fetch. Not counted as SSRF.
The README lists cross-site scripting, including the dust about page. Not counted.
import() extracts an uploaded zip under /tmp. Path traversal, not one of the four classes. Not counted.
The chat handler merges the request message with lodash. Prototype pollution is not SQL, NoSQL, command, or code injection. Not counted.
The README's package advisories (mongoose, st, ms, marked) are dependency versions. Not counted. The exec, find, and render sites are scored under injection.
The seeded admin user password is a training login, not a labeled secret. The session secret, logged token, and database password are the labeled secrets.
The in-memory chat user password is a training login. Not counted as a secret.

destroy and update load a todo by req.params.id with no session check. The README's code-vulnerability list does not name authorization or IDOR, and todos are not owned per user. Not counted, so a hit there is unmatched.
The development error handler is the README's security-misconfiguration item. Not one of the four classes. Not counted.
The README does not document an SSRF. The identify command is command injection. There is no server-side fetch of a caller-supplied URL, and no safe fetch look-alike. SSRF has no rows.
